guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture
guides.concept: 以跑道陷阱、分區搬運及中途量測解析Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture through racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Yb離子與集體模態。電場侷限帶電離子；集體運動模態提供部分糾纏閘的中介。 建立離子陷阱與模態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是跑道陷阱、分區搬運及中途量測。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。區分內部態、運動模態及環境噪聲三個子系統。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識光學地址與通道。光束位址將控制侷限到目標離子，但光學旁瓣及漂移可影響鄰近離子。 建立雷射位址與空間串擾的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是跑道陷阱、分區搬運及中途量測。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用位址矩陣比較目標響應與非目標響應。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識運動介導雙位元閘。兩離子控制需在閘結束後避免殘留態與運動糾纏，否則動作資訊成為噪聲。 建立運動介導的糾纏的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是跑道陷阱、分區搬運及中途量測。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較閉合與未閉合假想相空間軌跡。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識運算區排程。邏輯全連通不保證所有閘能同時執行；光學通道與模態共享形成排程限制。 建立連通性與排程的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是跑道陷阱、分區搬運及中途量測。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對相同閘集合比較串行及資源受限排程。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識跑道QCCD搬運。QCCD 以搬運及分區連接運算區；重排時間與加熱需納入總電路成本。 建立離子搬運與分區的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是跑道陷阱、分區搬運及中途量測。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫兩區搬運圖並分開閘時間、搬運及冷卻。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識中途螢光量測。讀出由散射光子統計決定；重置、旁觀者位元及量測時間影響中途量測。 建立螢光讀出與重用的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是跑道陷阱、分區搬運及中途量測。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩個計數分佈的指派錯誤並記錄讀出時窗。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify yb ions and collective modes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. Electric fields confine charged ions; collective motion mediates some entangling gates. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ion traps and modes, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate internal states, motional modes and environmental noise. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify optical addressing and channels in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. Beam addressing localizes control, but sidelobes and drift can affect neighbors. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of laser addressing and spatial crosstalk, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare intended and unintended responses in an addressing matrix. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify motion-mediated gates in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. Entangling control should avoid residual state-motion entanglement after a gate, or motion retains error-producing information. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of motion-mediated entanglement, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare closed and unclosed hypothetical phase-space paths. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify gate-zone scheduling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. Logical all-to-all connectivity does not imply unlimited parallel gates; shared optical channels and modes constrain scheduling. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of connectivity and scheduling, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare serial and resource-limited schedules for the same gate set. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify racetrack qccd transport in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. QCCD connects zones by transport; rearrangement time and heating contribute to circuit cost. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ion transport and zoning, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw a two-zone transport graph and separate gates, transport and cooling. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify mid-circuit fluorescence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. Readout uses photon-count statistics; reset, spectator qubits and duration affect mid-circuit measurement. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of fluorescence readout and reuse, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assignment errors for two count distributions and record the readout window. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

提交中途螢光量測的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

pitfalls: 常見誤判：較多光子必然改善整個電路且沒有反作用。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: More photons always improve the full circuit without back-action.
